scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @luckytoken/provider-contract && npm run build --workspace @luckytoken/commandcode-model-catalog && npm run build --workspace @luckytoken/provider-commandcode-private && npm run build --workspace @luckytoken/provider-commandcode-goat && npm run build --workspace @luckytoken/application-control-plane
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:root && npm run build --workspace @luckytoken/desktop-shell
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @luckytoken/provider-contract && npm run typecheck --workspace @luckytoken/commandcode-model-catalog && npm run typecheck --workspace @luckytoken/provider-commandcode-private && npm run typecheck --workspace @luckytoken/provider-commandcode-goat && npm run typecheck --workspace @luckytoken/application-control-plane && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @luckytoken/desktop-shell
scripts.test:inner: node --test test/certification/*.test.mjs && vitest run && npm test --workspace @luckytoken/desktop-shell
scripts.test:release:inner: node --test test/certification/*.test.mjs && vitest run --maxWorkers=4 && npm test --workspace @luckytoken/desktop-shell
scripts.test:online-codex:inner: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix onlinetest/codex_cli test --
scripts.test:online-claude:inner: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix onlinetest/claude test --
scripts.test:distribution:inner: npm run build && node --test test/distribution/*.test.mjs && npm test --workspace @luckytoken/desktop-shell && npm run test:product-e2e:run --workspace @luckytoken/desktop-shell
